# eunus.dev — Mohammad Eunus (Eunusur Rahaman)

> Software engineer specializing in AI-powered SaaS MVP development, ABP Framework/.NET modernization, and multi-tenant architecture. Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh; available for remote consulting engagements worldwide.

## Services

- [AI-Powered SaaS MVP Development](https://eunus.dev/consulting/): Multi-tenant SaaS products built with AI automation (Semantic Kernel, MCP servers) integrated from day one, not bolted on later. Full-stack delivery: .NET, Angular, Blazor, .NET MAUI, subscription billing, deployment.
- [Legacy System Modernization](https://eunus.dev/consulting/): ABP Framework / .NET modernization, security hardening, and DDD refactoring for aging or high-risk codebases — including rewriting a legacy hospital scheduling system.
- [Scale & Optimize](https://eunus.dev/consulting/): Performance and query tuning, architecture evolution, and microservices migration for products moving from MVP to enterprise scale.
- [Architecture & Code Reviews](https://eunus.dev/consulting/): Independent architecture reviews, codebase audits, team workshops, and technical hiring advice.
- [Contact](https://eunus.dev/contact/)

## Background

- 3+ years professional experience, 12+ systems shipped, 9 SaaS products delivered across 6 countries.
- Primary stack: ABP Framework, .NET/C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular, Blazor, .NET MAUI, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Entity Framework Core, OpenIddict, Semantic Kernel, MCP servers, Stripe.
- Applied domain experience: healthcare/hospital scheduling systems, multi-tenant booking and reservation platforms, and subscription-based SaaS billing.
- Development process integrates AI throughout: MCP-first API development, AI-assisted UI scaffolding, and AI-assisted log analysis in production.
